item.title: Inox Wind Hits New High In Q3 Fy26 Revenues, PAT Up 14%
item.description: Inox Wind Limited (IWL), announced its financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 on Feb 13. Q3 Fy26 was IWL's best-ever performance, posting revenues of Rs 1,238 crores, up 24% YoY, and EBITDA of Rs 313 crores, up 39% YoY. EBITDA margins came in at 25.2%. Profit before tax for the quarter was up 62% YoY to Rs 209 cr, while PAT was up 14% YoY at Rs 127 cr, despite a deferred tax charge of Rs 83 cr during the quarter (a non-cash accounting adjustment). item.title: Led By Renewables, India Adds Record 52 GW Power Capacity in 10 Months of FY26
item.description: India has added a record 52,537 MW of power generation capacity during the current financial year 2025–26, up to 31 January 2026, marking the highest-ever capacity addition in a single year, according to data released by the Ministry of Power. Renewables at the Forefront Of the total capacity added during the period, 39,657 MW came from renewable energy sources, underlining the accelerating pace of India’s clean energy transition. item.title: Andhra Pradesh Eyes Rs. 13,934 Cr Energy Allocation in 2026–27 Budget
item.description: Andhra Pradesh has been fast emerging as a hub for renewable energy since June 2024. Under the Integrated Clean Energy Policy, 55 projects worth Rs. 2.88 lakh crore have been allotted, covering 15.56 GW of solar, 4.86 GW of wind, 17.7 GW of PSP, and 1 MMTPA of green hydrogen, among others. item.title: Vayona Energy Bags First India Order with 64.8 MW Wind Turbine Deal from Oyster Renewable
item.description: Vayona Energy has announced its first deal in the Indian market, signing an agreement with Oyster Renewable Energy Private Limited for the supply of wind turbines for a 64.8 MW project in Kadapa district, Andhra Pradesh. The order marks a key milestone in Vayona Energy’s India entry strategy following its acquisition from Siemens Gamesa. item.title: Cosmic PV Adds 1.6 GW Capacity, 3 GW Capacity Positions It Among Leading OEM Manufacturers For Solar Modules
item.description: Cosmic PV Power Limited has commissioned a state-of-the-art 1.6 GW solar module production line in January 2026, doubling the company's manufacturing capacity to 3 GW on schedule with its broader plans. This rapid expansion solidifies Cosmic's position among India's largest OEM/ODM solar manufacturers and demonstrates the company's aggressive growth trajectory with a different go-to-market approach.
